entries.name: 凯尔特哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Forest grove, complete carved standing stones and tall Celtic cross, tree trunk spiral carvings, mossy stream and foreground spiral-carved rocks, distant misty valley and sunlight shafts. Preserve empty landscape with NO invented druids or extra people.

entries.name: 前苏格拉底哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Keep Mediterranean coast, boats and Greek temples, whole philosophical discussion and distinct pointing/observing gestures, geometry inscribed quietly on ground, water and foreground small fire as natural elements, starry sky and restrained cosmic circular traces. Oil refinement should use finer balanced strokes, not very chunky impasto or a swirling expressionist sky. Keep original light, scene layout and restrained individual faces.
